title: Alambardar aata hai
body:
Yeh Kaun Hai Falak Sara Larazta Hai
Yeh Kaun Hai Zameen Ka Dil Dharkta Hai
Alam Bardar Aata Hai Alam Bardar Aata Hai
Yeh Lagta Hai Keh Jaisay Haider-e-Karrar Aata Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Alam Thamay Hussaini Foaj Ka Salar Aata Hai
Falak Sara Larazta Hai Zameen Ka Dil Dharkta Hai
Fiza Mein Shoor Barpa Hai Addo Ka Dam Nikalta Hai
Jarri Yeh Kaun Aata Hai Alam Kis Ka Ubharta Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yazeedi Foaj Mein Halchal Dilon Pe Khof Chaya Hai
Jo Thi Karrar Ki Haibat Wohi Abbas Ki Haibat
Khuda Ke Shair Jaisi Hai Ali Ke Shair Ki Taqat
Wohi Chehra Wohi Seerat Wohi Jazba Wohi Jurat
<<DIVIDER>>
Abhi Aaya Nahi Lekin Addo Pe Cha Gayi Dehshat
Misal-e-La Fatah Shabeer Ka Salar Aata Hai
Abhi Yeh Shoor Barpa Tha Keh Gonja Haidery Narah
Misal-e-La Fatah Ghazi Achanak Samne Aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhe Abbas Kehte Hain Jarri Lalkar Kar Bola
Alamdar-e-Hussaini Hoon Ghulam-e-Syed-e-Wala
Sada Deta Howa Yeh Ghazi-e-Jarrar Aata Hai
Yahan Tanha Dil-e-Haider Wahan Lakhon Jafa Paikar
<<DIVIDER>>
Yahan Bas Hath Mein Naiza Wahan Taig-o-Sina Khanjar
Yahan Sokha Hai Mashkeza Wahan Serab Hai Lashkar
Yahan Shoq-e-Shahadat Hai Wahan Shoqeen-e-Maal-o-Zar
Moqabil Marhabon Ke Sahib-e-Kirdar Aata Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Addo Se Cheen Kar Darya Alam Abbas Ne Gara
Yazeedi Foaj Mein Oss Dam Achanak Shoor Yeh Utha
Aray Bhago Tarai Se Ali Aaya Ali Aaya
Phir Oss Ke Baad Darya Par Faqat Ghazi Nazar Aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jafa Karoon Mein Ban Kar Maut Ki Lalkar Aata Hai
Bhara Jis Waqt Mashkeza Bara Yaad Aayi Masoma
Liye Pani Soye Khaima Chala Saqqa Sakina Ka
Bhara Jab Gird Ghazi Ke Yazeedi Foaj Ka Halqa
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaha Abbas Ne Dil Mein Sakina Tum Na Ghabrana
Abhi Le Kar Yeh Mashkeza Tera Ghamkhuwar Aata Hai
Alam Ghazi Dilawar Ka Jab Oss Ke Khon Mein Doba
Bureda Bazoon Wala Na Mashkeza Bacha Paya
<<DIVIDER>>
Tarapta Khak Par Dekha Jo Sheh Ne Bhai Ka Lasha
Wafa Ko Naaz Hai Tujh Par Pukarey Syed-e-Wala
Khudaya Pas Ab Tere Mera Salar Aata Hai
